name: Wolfspeed Durham 150 mm device fab
summary: Wolfspeed's 150 mm silicon carbide device fab in Durham, North Carolina was still producing in mid-2024, when it recovered from an equipment incident. In August 2024 Wolfspeed said it would shift device output to its 200 mm Mohawk Valley fab and weigh when to shut Durham, and in November 2024 it announced the closure as part of a cost-cutting plan. The fab stopped producing in Wolfspeed's second fiscal quarter of 2026.

milestones.note: Production ceased in the second quarter of fiscal 2026, which ran from late September to late December 2025.

notes: This record covers the fab's closure. The closure was part of Wolfspeed's 2025 restructuring plan, described in its fiscal 2025 and 2026 annual reports, under which all power device production moved to the 200 mm fab in Marcy, New York.
